phases.name: Repair PR #40 checks
completed_items: Formatted ops/codex-runs/OPS-03/evidence/deployment/live-acceptance.json and verified it parses as JSON.

phases.name: Durable activation delivery
completed_items: Added additive encrypted lifecycle delivery outbox migration 2008_ops03a_lifecycle_delivery_outbox.sql.
Added additive post-activation MFA handoff migration 2009_ops03a_activation_mfa_handoffs.sql.

Encrypted activation/reset delivery payloads with AES-256-GCM using ONE_TIME_LIFECYCLE_DELIVERY_KEY, with key id/version, nonce, ciphertext, auth tag, expiry, destination ref, attempts, lease metadata, idempotency key, retry/dead-letter/supersede/expiry states.
Changed invitation lifetime to 24 hours while keeping password reset lifetime at 30 minutes.
Revoked earlier unconsumed same-account/purpose links on new issuance and superseded/cleared prior queued encrypted delivery material.
Added bounded sink worker processing with lease-safe claiming, retry/dead-letter behavior, expiry clearing, restart-safe state, and no raw token logging.
Wired lifecycle delivery processing into the existing worker one-shot and polling loops.

phases.name: Web activation, forgot-password, reset-password, and login experience
completed_items: Added branded noindex/no-referrer /activate, /forgot-password, and /reset-password pages.
Updated /login copy to Welcome back, removed the CRM subtitle, and added Forgot password?.
Added token-status, activation completion, forgot-password, reset-password, post-activation MFA activation, and recovery-code acknowledgement APIs.
Activation/reset links use URL fragments; the public client reads the token into memory and clears the fragment with history.replaceState.
The public client does not use localStorage, sessionStorage, analytics, screenshots, logs, error reporting, referrers, or window.prompt for lifecycle secrets.

phases.name: Roles and owner/admin MFA closeout
completed_items: Owner/admin activation creates the account password first, then provisions a short-lived post-activation MFA handoff.
Owner/admin activation does not create a normal session until TOTP is verified and recovery-code saved acknowledgement is submitted.
Parent/student activations continue to create role-scoped sessions without owner/admin MFA.
Existing parent-managed student setup/reset/suspend/restore behavior remains covered.
